name: Input Buffer
description: Input buffer, trajectory preview, and click shifting so clicks register on the first safe tick.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Tap jump slightly before landing and the jump comes out on the landing tick.

buffer-window.name: Buffer Window (ms)
buffer-window.description: How early you can tap before landing and still get the jump. At 240 physics ticks per second, 150 ms is about 36 ticks.

platformer-only.name: Platformer Levels Only
platformer-only.description: Only buffer inputs in platformer levels.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draws two paths ahead of your icon. Green: where you go if you click now. Red: where you go if you don't click.

trajectory-length.name: Trajectory Length (ms)
trajectory-length.description: How far ahead to predict. Longer is more expensive.

show-buffer-zone.name: Show Buffer Zone
show-buffer-zone.description: Highlights in yellow the part of the no-click path where an early tap will be caught by the buffer.

trajectory-practice-only.name: Trajectory in Practice Only
trajectory-practice-only.description: Only show the trajectory in practice mode.

smart-click.name: Enable Click Shifting
smart-click.description: When a click (or a release, in ship/wave/robot) would kill you and not doing it is safe, it's held back and registers on the first physics tick where it's safe. Turns itself off on orbs and while dashing.

smart-max-delay.name: Max Delay (ms)
smart-max-delay.description: How long a click can be held back. If it's still deadly after this, it's dropped.

smart-click-lookahead.name: Lookahead (ms)
smart-click-lookahead.description: How far ahead to check for death. Higher = safer but more cautious; lower = only reacts to deaths right in front of you.

auto-click.name: Auto Click
auto-click.description: Also clicks (or holds) for you when not clicking would kill you and clicking is safe. This plays for you: don't use it for verifying or rated runs.

smart-click-practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
smart-click-practice-only.description: Only use Click Shifting / Auto Click in practice mode.

smart-click-indicator.name: Show 'Smart Click' Label
smart-click-indicator.description: Shows a small label in the corner while Click Shifting or Auto Click is on.
